title: Policies for information security
objective: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.
evidence_source: Google Workspace / Confluence Policy Portal
soa_justification: Mandatory foundational control providing high-level executive direction and accountability for the organization's ISMS.

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
objective: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.
evidence_source: HR Org Chart & Job Descriptions
soa_justification: Establishes formal RACI matrix and lines of accountability across corporate leadership.

title: Segregation of duties
objective: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.
evidence_source: GitHub Branch Protection & Okta Role RBAC
soa_justification: Prevents unauthorized modifications to production code, infrastructure, and financial ledgers.

title: Management responsibilities
objective: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy and topic-specific policies of the organization.
evidence_source: Executive Management Review Minutes
soa_justification: Ensures executive leadership enforces security policy compliance across departmental heads.

title: Contact with authorities
objective: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.
evidence_source: Regulatory Contact Register (CERT-In / FTC / Data Protection Authority)
soa_justification: Required for statutory notifications of critical cybersecurity incidents and data breaches.

title: Contact with special interest groups
objective: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.
evidence_source: ISAC & OWASP Membership Records
soa_justification: Keeps engineering abreast of emerging threat vectors, zero-days, and peer intelligence.

title: Threat intelligence
objective: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.
evidence_source: CrowdStrike Falcon / AlienVault OTX Feed
soa_justification: 2022 new control: proactive consumption of IoCs and attacker TTPs to fortify defenses.

title: Information security in project management
objective: Information security shall be integrated into project management.
evidence_source: Jira Product Spec Security Checklists
soa_justification: Ensures security risk assessments precede any engineering sprint or infrastructure deployment.

title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
objective: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.
evidence_source: AWS Systems Manager & Kandji MDM API
soa_justification: You cannot secure what you do not know. Real-time asset inventory across cloud and endpoints.

title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
objective: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.
evidence_source: Employee Onboarding Attestation Platform
soa_justification: Sets enforceable boundaries for workstation, corporate email, and cloud storage usage.

title: Return of assets
objective: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organization's assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.
evidence_source: Offboarding Checklist / Kandji MDM Remote Wipe
soa_justification: Prevents unauthorized data retention by exiting employees or contractors.

title: Classification of information
objective: Information shall be classified in accordance with the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.
evidence_source: Data Classification Standard (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted)
soa_justification: Enables tiered protection controls aligned to data sensitivity and regulatory impact.

title: Labelling of information
objective: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.
evidence_source: Google Workspace DLP Data Loss Prevention Labels
soa_justification: Automated tagging of customer PII and restricted IP in email and documents.

title: Information transfer
objective: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.
evidence_source: TLS 1.3 Cipher Enforcement & AWS S3 Bucket Policies
soa_justification: Protects electronic data in transit across public and external network channels.

title: Access control
objective: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and documented based on business and information security requirements.
evidence_source: Access Control Policy & Okta Group RBAC Rules
soa_justification: Critical baseline ensuring need-to-know access restriction across all corporate digital assets.

title: Identity management
objective: The full lifecycle of identities shall be managed.
evidence_source: Okta SCIM User Lifecycle Automation
soa_justification: Automates onboarding, role provisioning, and immediate deprovisioning on departure.

title: Authentication information
objective: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.
evidence_source: FIDO2 WebAuthn & Okta Verify Telemetry
soa_justification: Enforces phishing-resistant MFA tokens and secrets management for all corporate staff.

title: Access rights
objective: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on and rules for access control.
evidence_source: Quarterly User Access Review (UAR) Campaign Logs
soa_justification: Quarterly privilege audits to remove orphan accounts and prevent privilege creep.

title: Information security in supplier relationships
objective: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services.
evidence_source: Third-Party Vendor Risk Register & SIG Questionnaires
soa_justification: Evaluates cybersecurity and compliance risks of all external SaaS and vendor providers.

title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
objective: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.
evidence_source: Standard DPA & Security Addendums in DocuSign
soa_justification: Binds suppliers to breach notification SLAs, right to audit, and encryption standards.

title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
objective: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
evidence_source: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) & Dependabot Scanning
soa_justification: Protects against upstream software supply chain compromises and vulnerable dependencies.

title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
objective: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.
evidence_source: Annual SOC 2 Type II Report Reviews of Critical Vendors
soa_justification: Tracks external vendor security audits and service modification notices.

title: Information security for use of cloud services
objective: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
evidence_source: AWS Well-Architected Review & Cloud Custodian Policies
soa_justification: 2022 new control: defines shared responsibility model, architecture, and exit strategy for cloud.

title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
objective: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.
evidence_source: Incident Response Plan (IRP) v3.2 & Tabletop Exercise Report
soa_justification: Establishes incident severity tiers, escalation playbooks, and communications protocol.

title: Assessment and decision on information security events
objective: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.
evidence_source: SIEM Automated Triage Rules (Datadog Security Monitoring)
soa_justification: Filters raw telemetry to isolate actionable security incidents without alert fatigue.

title: Response to information security incidents
objective: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
evidence_source: PagerDuty Incident Bridge & Root Cause Analyses
soa_justification: Guides containment, eradication, and post-incident recovery procedures.

title: Learning from information security incidents
objective: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.
evidence_source: Blameless Post-Mortem Repositories
soa_justification: Feeds incident findings back into preventive engineering and risk assessment registers.

title: Collection of evidence
objective: The organization shall define and apply procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.
evidence_source: Immutable S3 Object-Locked Forensic Evidence Store
soa_justification: Ensures chain of custody and forensic admissibility for legal and law enforcement use.

title: Information security during disruption
objective: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
evidence_source: Business Continuity Plan (BCP) & Disaster Recovery Runbook
soa_justification: Maintains encryption and access control guardrails even when operating in failover modes.

title: ICT readiness for business continuity
objective: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
evidence_source: Multi-Region Cloud Failover Simulation Drill Results
soa_justification: 2022 new control: verifies RTO and RPO targets across production cloud infrastructure.

title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
objective: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.
evidence_source: Legal Compliance Matrix (GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP Act 2023)
soa_justification: Ensures systematic alignment with cross-border data protection and industry legislation.

title: Intellectual property rights
objective: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
evidence_source: Proprietary Software Copyrights & FOSSA License Audits
soa_justification: Protects trade secrets and prevents open-source copyleft licensing infractions.

title: Protection of records
objective: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release in accordance with legal, statutory, regulatory, contractual and business requirements.
evidence_source: 7-Year S3 Glacier Immutable Retention Vault
soa_justification: Meets financial and corporate tax statutory document preservation mandates.

title: Privacy and protection of PII
objective: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements.
evidence_source: Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) & RoPA Records
soa_justification: Serves as direct structural hinge to ISO/IEC 27701:2025 and privacy regulations.

title: Independent review of information security
objective: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes and technologies shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur.
evidence_source: External ISO 27001 Surveillance Audit Report (Schellman)
soa_justification: Provides third-party accredited validation of ISMS operational effectiveness.

title: Compliance with policies and standards for information security
objective: Managers shall regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility with the appropriate security policies, topic-specific policies and standards.
evidence_source: Continuous Compliance Monitoring Dashboard
soa_justification: Validates that departmental practices adhere strictly to documented policies.

title: Documented operating procedures
objective: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.
evidence_source: Git-Backed Engineering Runbook Docs
soa_justification: Eliminates single points of failure by maintaining explicit operational standard operating procedures.

title: Screening
objective: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics and should be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.
evidence_source: Checkr Background Check Integration
soa_justification: Validates candidate criminal background, identity, and education prior to provisioning access.

title: Terms and conditions of employment
objective: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security.
evidence_source: Executed Employment Agreements & Handbooks
soa_justification: Legally binds all staff to security directives from day one of tenure.

title: Information security awareness, education and training
objective: Personnel of the organization and, where relevant, contractors shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.
evidence_source: KnowBe4 Security Training LMS & Phishing Simulation Metrics
soa_justification: Educates staff against social engineering, business email compromise, and credential phishing.

title: Disciplinary process
objective: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.
evidence_source: Corporate Disciplinary Framework Document
soa_justification: Defines escalating disciplinary consequences for intentional security violations.

title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
objective: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.
evidence_source: Offboarding Confidentiality Reminder Attestation
soa_justification: Ensures post-employment confidentiality obligations endure indefinitely.

title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
objective: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties.
evidence_source: DocuSign NDA Registry
soa_justification: Legally restricts disclosure of proprietary source code, IP, and client customer data.

title: Remote working
objective: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises.
evidence_source: Tailscale Zero-Trust Remote Access & FileVault MDM
soa_justification: 2022 revised control: mandates disk encryption, VPN/zero-trust, and split-tunnel security for remote staff.

title: Information security event reporting
objective: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.
evidence_source: Slack #security-incident Bot & PhishAlarm Button
soa_justification: Empowers employees to immediately report suspicious emails, anomalies, or lost devices.

title: Physical security perimeters
objective: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
evidence_source: Physical Facility Lease Agreement & Perimeter Badge Controls
soa_justification: Ensures commercial building entry requires biometric/badge verification before office access.

title: Physical entry
objective: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.
evidence_source: Brivo Cloud Access Card Reader Logs
soa_justification: Controls access to corporate offices, server rooms, and executive suites.

title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
objective: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented.
evidence_source: Physical Security Quarterly Walkthrough Audit
soa_justification: Restricts internal areas containing confidential paper records or comms wiring.

title: Physical security monitoring
objective: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
evidence_source: Verkada CCTV Cloud Recording with 90-Day Retention
soa_justification: 2022 new control: continuous video surveillance and intrusion alarm telemetry at facility entrances.

title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
objective: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure shall be designed and implemented.
evidence_source: Fire Suppression & Climate Control Inspection Certificates
soa_justification: Protects on-site network racks against fire, water leakage, and temperature spikes.

title: Working in secure areas
objective: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.
evidence_source: Clean Room and Data Closet Operating Guide
soa_justification: Restricts unaccompanied visitor and vendor access to sensitive network enclosures.

title: Clear desk and clear screen
objective: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.
evidence_source: Kandji MDM 5-Minute Inactive Screen Lock Policy
soa_justification: Enforces automated workstation locking and mandates locking physical filing cabinets.

title: Equipment siting and protection
objective: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce risks from environmental threats and hazards, and opportunities for unauthorized access.
evidence_source: Rack Enclosure Environmental Sensors Telemetry
soa_justification: Ensures physical switches and power supplies are housed in locked, ventilated cabinets.

title: Security of assets off-premises
objective: Off-site assets shall be protected.
evidence_source: BitLocker / FileVault Hardware Encryption Telemetry
soa_justification: Guarantees corporate laptops operating outside the office have full disk encryption enforced.

title: Storage media
objective: Storage media shall be managed through their lifecycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organization's classification scheme and handling requirements.
evidence_source: USB Mass Storage Disablement MDM Profile
soa_justification: Prevents unauthorized data exfiltration via thumb drives and manages decommissioning.

title: Supporting utilities
objective: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.
evidence_source: UPS Battery Backup Maintenance Log
soa_justification: Ensures orderly shutdown of local edge network appliances during municipal power loss.

title: Cabling security
objective: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.
evidence_source: Conduit Infrastructure Inspection Report
soa_justification: Prevents unauthorized physical wiretapping or accidental cable severance.

title: Equipment maintenance
objective: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure its continued availability and integrity.
evidence_source: Vendor Hardware Maintenance Contracts
soa_justification: Ensures manufacturer warranty coverage and firmware patch application.

title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
objective: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.
evidence_source: NIST 800-88 De-gaussing & Destruction Certificates (e-Waste Partner)
soa_justification: Certifies total cryptographic erasure of discarded SSDs and hard drives.

title: User endpoint devices
objective: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.
evidence_source: Kandji / Intune MDM Health & CrowdStrike EDR Agent
soa_justification: Enforces EDR, automatic OS patching, and firewall on all employee laptops.

title: Privileged access rights
objective: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
evidence_source: AWS IAM Identity Center / PIM Just-In-Time Elevation Logs
soa_justification: Disallows permanent admin rights; requires temporary MFA session elevation.

title: Information access restriction
objective: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.
evidence_source: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security & AWS KMS Envelope Policies
soa_justification: Restricts database queries to authenticated tenant scopes and designated services.

title: Access to source code
objective: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.
evidence_source: GitHub Enterprise Organization RBAC & 2FA Enforcement
soa_justification: Protects core intellectual property and prohibits direct commits to main branch.

title: Secure authentication
objective: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
evidence_source: Okta FastPass Phishing-Resistant FIDO2 Authentication
soa_justification: Eliminates plain password vulnerabilities via hardware-backed WebAuthn authenticators.

title: Capacity management
objective: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.
evidence_source: AWS CloudWatch Auto-Scaling Triggers & Memory/Disk Alarms
soa_justification: Prevents denial of service caused by unexpected traffic surges or resource exhaustion.

title: Protection against malware
objective: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
evidence_source: CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor Live Quarantine Status
soa_justification: Blocks ransomware, trojans, and malicious payloads at kernel runtime.

title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
objective: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated and appropriate measures taken.
evidence_source: Snyk Container & AWS Inspector Automated Scans
soa_justification: Identifies unpatched CVEs across base images and infrastructure packages with SLA tracking.

title: Configuration management
objective: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
evidence_source: Terraform Cloud Baseline Drift Detection & AWS Config
soa_justification: 2022 new control: mandates Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) configuration baselines and drift enforcement.

title: Information deletion
objective: Data stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.
evidence_source: AWS S3 Lifecycle Expiration Rules & Cron Deletion Workers
soa_justification: 2022 new control: enforces storage limitation and automated deletion of expired PII.

title: Data masking
objective: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.
evidence_source: PostgreSQL Dynamic Masking & Logging Filter Regex
soa_justification: 2022 new control: ensures credit cards, passwords, and PII are redacted from application logs.

title: Data leakage prevention
objective: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.
evidence_source: Google Workspace DLP & Nightfall API Cloud DLP
soa_justification: 2022 new control: monitors outbound transfers, webhooks, and attachments for data leaks.

title: Information backup
objective: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.
evidence_source: AWS Backup Automated Daily Snapshots & Drill Verification
soa_justification: Ensures encrypted, air-gapped snapshots exist to recover from ransomware or database corruption.

title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
objective: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.
evidence_source: Multi-AZ Aurora Cluster & Multi-Zone Kubernetes Nodes
soa_justification: Eliminates single points of failure across power, networking, and server instances.

title: Logging
objective: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
evidence_source: AWS CloudTrail & Datadog Centralized Log Pipeline
soa_justification: Generates immutable audit trails of API requests, logins, and system changes.

title: Monitoring activities
objective: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behavior and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
evidence_source: Datadog SIEM Anomaly Detection & PagerDuty Alerts
soa_justification: 2022 new control: continuous telemetry monitoring for unauthorized egress or suspicious access spikes.

title: Clock synchronization
objective: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.
evidence_source: Amazon Time Sync Service (NTP) Stratum 1 Telemetry
soa_justification: Crucial for reliable timestamp correlation during security incident investigations.

title: Use of privileged utility programs
objective: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.
evidence_source: Linux sudoers Audit & Teleport Session Recording
soa_justification: Prevents unauthorized debugger or direct raw disk editor execution on production hosts.

title: Installation of software on operational systems
objective: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.
evidence_source: Immutable Read-Only Container RootFS & AppLocker Policies
soa_justification: Disallows ad-hoc binary installation on production compute nodes.

title: Networks security
objective: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
evidence_source: AWS Security Groups, VPC Route Tables & NACLs
soa_justification: Blocks unsolicited inbound traffic and enforces egress filtering.

title: Security of network services
objective: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.
evidence_source: Cloudflare Enterprise SLA & DDoS Protection Status
soa_justification: Governs managed DNS, CDN, and WAF perimeter security services.

title: Segregation of networks
objective: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on the organization's networks.
evidence_source: AWS VPC Private Subnet Isolation & Calico Network Policies
soa_justification: Isolates production databases from public-facing web servers and corporate VPNs.

title: Web filtering
objective: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
evidence_source: Cloudflare Gateway DNS / NextDNS Content Filter Logs
soa_justification: 2022 new control: prevents employees from navigating to known malware, C2, and phishing domains.

title: Use of cryptography
objective: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
evidence_source: AWS KMS Automatic Annual Key Rotation Telemetry
soa_justification: Mandates AES-256 for storage volumes and automated KMS envelope encryption.

title: Secure development life cycle
objective: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
evidence_source: Secure SDLC Policy & GitHub Branch Protection Configuration
soa_justification: Embeds automated security guardrails across sprint planning, code review, and CI/CD.

title: Application security requirements
objective: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
evidence_source: Architectural RFCs & Threat Modeling Templates
soa_justification: Validates authentication, tenant segregation, and data integrity requirements before development.

title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
objective: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.
evidence_source: Zero-Trust System Architecture Whitepaper
soa_justification: 2022 revised control: enforces defense-in-depth, fail-safe defaults, and least privilege in designs.

title: Secure coding
objective: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
evidence_source: GitHub Actions CodeQL & Semgrep Static Analysis Pipeline
soa_justification: 2022 new control: automated SAST scanning to block OWASP Top 10 flaws before code merge.

title: Security testing in development and acceptance
objective: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
evidence_source: Automated DAST (OWASP ZAP) & Annual CREST Pen-Test Report
soa_justification: Validates dynamic application resilience against SQLi, XSS, and broken object level auth.

title: Outsourced development
objective: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.
evidence_source: Contractor Code Review Checklist & Dedicated Branch Sandbox
soa_justification: Subjects external engineering contractors to mandatory internal automated security gates.

title: Separation of development, test and production environments
objective: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.
evidence_source: AWS Organizations Isolated Accounts (Dev vs Staging vs Prod)
soa_justification: Prevents untested code from breaking production and isolates sensitive customer data.

title: Change management
objective: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.
evidence_source: GitHub Pull Request Mandatory Peer Review & CI Approval Gates
soa_justification: Ensures all changes are tested, peer-approved, and documented before deployment.

title: Test information
objective: Test information shall be appropriately selected, secured and managed.
evidence_source: Synthetic Seed Data Generation Scripts
soa_justification: Strictly prohibits copying production customer PII into staging or local dev databases.

title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
objective: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving the assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
evidence_source: Pen-Test Rules of Engagement (RoE) Document
soa_justification: Prevents invasive vulnerability scanners from causing outages on production clusters.
